facts: We regret to inform you that the claim for orthopedic treatment in the U.S. is not covered under your policy.

Treatment or part of treatment for any condition which is not Life threatening in nature and can be safely postponed till the Insured Person returns to India. vi. Medical treatment taken outside India if that is the sole reason or one of the reasons for the journey. vi. Any treatment of orthopaedic diseases or conditions except for fractures, dislocations and / or Injuries suffered during the Policy Period.

cited_clauses.quote: Treatment or part of treatment for any condition which is not Life threatening in nature and can be safely postponed till the Insured Person returns to India.
Medical treatment taken outside India if that is the sole reason or one of the reasons for the journey.
Any treatment of orthopaedic diseases or conditions except for fractures, dislocations and / or Injuries suffered during the Policy Period.

reasoning: The policy explicitly excludes medical treatment taken outside India if it is the sole reason for the journey and any treatment of orthopaedic diseases or conditions except for fractures, dislocations, or injuries suffered during the Policy Period. These exclusions support the insurer's rejection of the claim.
relief_sought: We request the insurer to reconsider the rejection and cover the claim for orthopedic treatment in the U.S.
document_checklist: Copy of the claim rejection letter
Medical bills, prescriptions and investigation reports
Earlier correspondence with the insurer, including any grievance acknowledgement
deadline_note: A complaint to the Insurance Ombudsman needs a written representation to the insurer first; it must then be made within one year of the insurer's rejection, or of one month after the representation was sent (Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017, Rule 14(3), checked against the published text as amended till 09.11.2023; later amendments not checked). Confirm with the Ombudsman office before relying on a date, and compute dates with the deadline tool.
